# Kubernetes

> > Production-grade container orchestration platform for automating deployment, scaling, and management of containerized applications

Kubernetes is an open-source system originally developed by Google based on their Borg cluster-management system. The site provides documentation, community updates, release announcements, and technical guides for running containerized workloads across cloud providers including GCE, AWS, and Azure.

## Key Topics

- Container orchestration
- Cluster management
- Cloud-native computing
- Deployment automation
- Autoscaling and scaling
- Multi-zone clusters and high availability
- Network policy and Ingress
- Docker containers
- Google Container Engine (GKE)
- Cluster federation
- SIG (Special Interest Groups)
- KubeCon conferences
- API versioning (v1beta3, 1.2, 1.3)
- Open-source community

## Getting Started

- [Kubernetes](https://kubernetes.io): Homepage for Kubernetes production-grade container orchestration platform
- [Borg: The Predecessor to Kubernetes](https://kubernetes.io/blog/2015/04/borg-predecessor-to-kubernetes): Google's Borg cluster-management system as Kubernetes predecessor

## Core Features and Architecture

- [Building highly available applications using Kubernetes new multi-zone clusters (a.k.a. 'Ubernetes Lite')](https://kubernetes.io/blog/2016/03/building-highly-available-applications-using-kubernetes-new-multi-zone-clusters-aka-ubernetes-lite): Multi-zone cluster support in Kubernetes 1.2 for high availability
- [Kubernetes 1.2 and simplifying advanced networking with Ingress](https://kubernetes.io/blog/2016/03/kubernetes-1-2-and-simplifying-advanced-networking-with-ingress): Ingress object improvements for inbound cluster networking in K8s 1.2
- [SIG-Networking: Kubernetes Network Policy APIs Coming in 1.3](https://kubernetes.io/blog/2016/04/kubernetes-network-policy-apis): Network policy APIs for security and multi-tenancy coming in K8s 1.3
- [Autoscaling in Kubernetes](https://kubernetes.io/blog/2016/07/autoscaling-in-kubernetes): Cluster autoscaling feature introduced in Kubernetes 1.3 for GCE/GKE
- [Simple leader election with Kubernetes and Docker](https://kubernetes.io/blog/2016/01/simple-leader-election-with-kubernetes): Tutorial on implementing leader election in distributed apps using K8s

## Performance and Scalability

- [Kubernetes Performance Measurements and Roadmap](https://kubernetes.io/blog/2015/09/kubernetes-performance-measurements-and): Performance benchmarks and scalability roadmap for 100-node clusters
- [Bringing End-to-End Kubernetes Testing to Azure (Part 1)](https://kubernetes.io/blog/2016/06/bringing-end-to-end-testing-to-azure): AppFormix's approach to end-to-end Kubernetes testing on Azure platform

## Use Cases and Tutorials

- [Using Spark and Zeppelin to process big data on Kubernetes 1.2](https://kubernetes.io/blog/2016/03/using-spark-and-zeppelin-to-process-big-data-on-kubernetes): Running Apache Spark and Zeppelin for big data processing on Kubernetes 1.2
- [Creating a Raspberry Pi cluster running Kubernetes, the shopping list (Part 1)](https://kubernetes.io/blog/2015/11/creating-a-raspberry-pi-cluster-running-kubernetes-the-shopping-list-part-1): Hardware shopping list for building Raspberry Pi Kubernetes cluster
- [SIG-UI: the place for building awesome user interfaces for Kubernetes](https://kubernetes.io/blog/2016/04/building-awesome-user-interfaces-for-kubernetes): SIG-UI mission and Dashboard UI projects for Kubernetes user interfaces

## Community and News

- [Kubernetes Blog](https://kubernetes.io/blog): Main blog hub featuring community updates, SIG announcements, and releases
- [A Very Happy Birthday Kubernetes](https://kubernetes.io/blog/2016/07/happy-k8sbday-1): First anniversary celebration of Kubernetes 1.0 launch at OSCON
- [Happy Birthday Kubernetes. Oh, the places you'll go!](https://kubernetes.io/blog/2016/07/oh-the-places-you-will-go): Justin Santa Barbara's reflection on Kubernetes first year anniversary
- [KubeCon EU 2016: Kubernetes Community in London](https://kubernetes.io/blog/2016/02/kubecon-eu-2016-kubernetes-community-in): Announcement for inaugural KubeCon EU 2016 conference in London
- [State of the Container World, January 2016](https://kubernetes.io/blog/2016/02/state-of-container-world-january-2016): Survey results on container adoption and deployment statistics from Jan 2016

- [Kubernetes Release: 0.17.0](https://kubernetes.io/blog/2015/05/kubernetes-release-0170): Release notes for Kubernetes 0.17.0 with v1beta3 API migration updates
